name: v1.4.0
body:
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ruanformigoni/gameimage/compare/v1.3.1...v1.4.0

* Integration with novel C++ version of FlatImage
* FlatImages are now imutable, when used with sync services like mega or dropbox, it will not trigger syncs between executions
* Desktop integration is now optional
* Both wizard and launcher now run on wayland natively
* It is now possible to select a compression level for each game
* Fixed scaling issues in launcher
* Fixed font-size issues
* Integration with UMU and proton-ge
* Reworked linux wizard to allow inclusion of single binary / humble bundle games
* Included version check before fetch screen
* Fixed issues with ubuntu
* Fixed truncated output of terminal in wizard

name: v1.1.1
body:
## What's Changed
* Use Ipc to keep all download logic in backend by @ruanformigoni in https://github.com/ruanformigoni/gameimage/pull/64
* Removed unnecessary --output-file argument by @ruanformigoni in https://github.com/ruanformigoni/gameimage/pull/65
* Use Ipc to fetch file list / urls from the backend by @ruanformigoni in https://github.com/ruanformigoni/gameimage/pull/67
* Use ipc for backend search by @ruanformigoni in https://github.com/ruanformigoni/gameimage/pull/68
* Remove backend logic from common by @ruanformigoni in https://github.com/ruanformigoni/gameimage/pull/69
* On linux, check if `.sh` file exists before proceeeding to select rom frame


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ruanformigoni/gameimage/compare/v1.1.0...v1.1.1

name: v1.1.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Option to use custom tarball for wine by @ruanformigoni in https://github.com/ruanformigoni/gameimage/pull/63
* New field `wine_custom` allows the usage of a custom wine tarball from the provided url.
* Move SHA checks to the backend
* Support for sha512 checks
* Support for file integrity checks



**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ruanformigoni/gameimage/compare/v1.0.3...v1.1.0

name: v1.0.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Rework project in C++ by @ruanformigoni in https://github.com/ruanformigoni/gameimage/pull/45

## Project overhaul:
* Completely GUI-Oriented process for GameImage creation
* Rewrite of the backend in C++
* Updated runners to latest flatimage
* Simplify launcher, indicate that the application is running with grayed out cover image
